method: NOAA monthly 0.25-degree OISST analysis: satellite and in-situ inputs blended and gaps filled by the original analysis. Preserve returned Float32 values, grid-cell centers, UTC months and original land/missing mask. No app interpolation or spatial averaging. Display values only are rounded. Natural Earth coast clipped and topology-preserving simplification 0.003 degree. Map latitude scale corrected by cosine of the region midpoint.
scope: 2023 monthly maps for Korea, Solomon Islands and Sydney; Korea also January/July 2019–2022 (2023 duplicates independently matched). A minus/B minus calculations use the same cell. Annual series is 2023 only. Not raw GK2A imagery, ten-day composites, current-year or live satellite retrieval.
